subject: science
passage: A single dandelion plant can produce hundreds of seeds, each attached to a tiny parachute of fine white bristles. When the wind blows, these parachutes carry the seeds away from the parent plant, sometimes for more than a kilometer. This helps dandelions ______ across large areas, which is one reason they appear in so many lawns and fields.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: The text says wind carries dandelion seeds "away from the parent plant, sometimes for more than a kilometer," and that dandelions "appear in so many lawns and fields." The blank must mean "move out over a wide area," so "spread" fits.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The sentence describes plants moving into new areas, which is the opposite of resting in one place.
explanation.B: Incorrect. Seeds carried far away produce more dandelions in more places; the plants grow in range rather than shrink.
explanation.C: Correct. Wind carries the seeds far from the parent plant, so new dandelions grow over a wide area. That is what it means for the plants to spread.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Nothing in the text suggests the plants droop or dry out; the passage is about how they reach new places.
